get.description: Lists the runs started since the API came up, newest first.

post.description:
Spins off the agents: searches the portals, scores the positions and saves them to the DB.
Returns immediately with a run id; poll GET /agents/runs/{run_id} for the result.

get.description: Status of one run; summary (positions found, scored, ingested, errors) is set once it finishes.

Chart tables over every saved job (status counts, funnel, work type, company,
compatibility, weekly activity). Fast: host pandas only, no LLM or sandbox.
For near-miss jobs, skill gaps, the written analysis and side projects, start
POST /agents/analytics/runs.

post.description:
Spins off the analytics agent: it runs code in a sandbox to find the near-miss jobs
and skill gaps, writes the analysis and recommends side projects. Takes a few minutes.
Returns immediately with a run id; poll GET /agents/analytics/runs/{run_id} for the report.

get.description: Status of one analytics run; report is set once it succeeds.

post.description:
Builds a Markdown resume tailored to a saved job from the user's knowledge base and
projects, plus side-project ideas for the skills the job asks for that the user lacks.
Takes a minute or two (two LLM calls). The result is saved as a new resume draft
(draft_id) that GET /agents/resume/drafts/{draft_id} and the resume chat work on.

get.description: Lists saved resume drafts, most recently edited first; only one job's when job_id is given.
One resume draft: its current resume and side projects, chat history and older versions.

put.description: Saves a manual edit of a draft's resume and/or side projects; the old content becomes a version.

post.description: Restores versions[version] of a draft; the current content is kept as a new version first.

get.description: Names of the enabled portals in portals.yml, for the frontend's portal picker.
Positive title_filter keywords in portals.yml: the positions the portal search targets.

Job board for the frontend: filters, sorts and paginates the jobs the agents saved.
e.g. GET /jobs?action=searched&min_compatibility=70&sort_by=compatibility
One job with its full description, for the job detail page.

patch.description:
Sets the application status of a job (applied, interview_scheduled, ...).
Re-running the agents keeps this status (see dbOps.upsert_jobs).

get.description: Liveness check for the frontend / docker.

ActionRow.title: ActionRow
ActionRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.by_action: how many jobs have each status, zeros included.

AgentRun.title: AgentRun
AgentRun.description:
Returned by POST /agents/runs, GET /agents/runs and GET /agents/runs/{run_id};
the frontend polls it until status is succeeded or failed.

AgentRunRequest.title: AgentRunRequest
AgentRunRequest.description: Body of POST /agents/runs: which portals to search and which sandbox to use.

AgentRunSummary.title: AgentRunSummary
AgentRunSummary.description: What a finished run did: portal_search -> qualification_check -> db_ingestion.

AnalyticsReport.title: AnalyticsReport
AnalyticsReport.description:
Analytics over every saved job. GET /agents/analytics returns only `tables` (host
pandas, fast); a finished analytics run (agents/graph/analytic_graph.py) fills the rest.
The tables are built by agents/analytics/agent.py build_tables().

AnalyticsRun.title: AnalyticsRun
AnalyticsRun.description:
Returned by POST /agents/analytics/runs and GET /agents/analytics/runs/{run_id};
the frontend polls it until status is succeeded or failed, then reads `report`.

AnalyticsRunRequest.title: AnalyticsRunRequest
AnalyticsRunRequest.description:
Body of POST /agents/analytics/runs: which sandbox the analytics agent runs its code in.
It only needs pandas, so sandbox-cpu is enough.

AnalyticsTables.title: AnalyticsTables
AnalyticsTables.description: The chart tables of AnalyticsReport, built by agents/analytics/agent.py build_tables().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description:
One message of a resume draft's chat; assistant messages hold only the reply text,
the doc edits they made are in ResumeDraftOut.versions.

CompanyRow.title: CompanyRow
CompanyRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.by_company, most found first.

CompatibilityRow.title: CompatibilityRow
CompatibilityRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.compatibility: the 0-10 compatibility score histogram.

DraftVersion.title: DraftVersion
DraftVersion.description: A resume draft's content before one edit (a chat edit, a manual save or a revert).

FunnelRow.title: FunnelRow
FunnelRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.funnel: found -> applied -> interview -> interview_done.

JobActionUpdate.title: JobActionUpdate
JobActionUpdate.description: Body of PATCH /jobs/{job_id}/action: set the application status of a job.

JobOut.title: JobOut
JobOut.description: One job_board_table row, as returned by GET /jobs and GET /jobs/{job_id}.

JobPage.title: JobPage
JobPage.description: Response of GET /jobs: one page of filtered jobs plus the total match count.

JobTypeRow.title: JobTypeRow
JobTypeRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.by_job_type: jobs found, applied to and interviewed per work type.

NearMissJob.title: NearMissJob
NearMissJob.description:
Row of AnalyticsReport.near_miss_jobs: a job you're broadly qualified for that misses
at least one required skill (agents/analytics/agent.py NEAR_MISS_COLUMNS).

ResumeDraftOut.title: ResumeDraftOut
ResumeDraftOut.description:
A saved resume draft, as returned by GET/PUT /agents/resume/drafts/{draft_id}, the revert
route and the chat websocket's "done" event: the current docs, the chat and older versions.

ResumeDraftSummary.title: ResumeDraftSummary
ResumeDraftSummary.description: One row of GET /agents/resume/drafts: a saved resume draft without its content.

ResumeDraftUpdate.title: ResumeDraftUpdate
ResumeDraftUpdate.description:
Body of PUT /agents/resume/drafts/{draft_id}: a manual edit from the UI.
Fields left out are not changed; the old content is kept as a version.

ResumeReport.title: ResumeReport
ResumeReport.description:
Response of POST /agents/resume/{job_id}: a Markdown resume tailored to the saved
job, plus Markdown side-project ideas that close its skill gaps. Saved as the resume
draft draft_id, which the resume chat edits.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: Lifecycle of a graph run: queued -> running -> succeeded | failed.

SideProject.title: SideProject
SideProject.description: A side project the analytics agent recommends to close skill gaps from the near-miss jobs.

SkillGap.title: SkillGap
SkillGap.description:
Row of AnalyticsReport.skill_gaps: a skill missing across the near-miss jobs
(agents/analytics/agent.py SKILL_GAP_COLUMNS).

WeeklyRow.title: WeeklyRow
WeeklyRow.description: Row of AnalyticsTables.weekly: jobs by week of their last update, one count per action.
